arguments.label: Inspect measurements.json
arguments.command: cd /workspace/task && ls -la scratch/ && head -c 2000 scratch/measurements.json && echo && md5sum scratch/measurements.json

cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('scratch/measurements.json',encoding='utf-8'))
v=[r['value'] for r in d if isinstance(r.get('value'),(int,float)) and not isinstance(r.get('value'),bool) and 10<=r['value']<20]
json.dump({'count':len(v),'sum':sum(v)},open('scratch/stats.json','w',encoding='utf-8'),ensure_ascii=False)
" && cat scratch/stats.json && echo && md5sum scratch/measurements.json
